We were hoping to use our break in the beginning in the same way as JDplays so that everyone could connect. However, there was a miscommunication and the beginning where the map is generated and the start button is pressed was not recorded at all. The cutscene is still clearly shown.

The time entered was arrived at by subtracting the 0:0:10 mark when the game was unpaused from the 4:33:59 finish time and adding 2 seconds (probably fewer) for time taken to pause the game, under the assumption that the time for players to connect can be counted as a break.

The run is also special in other more fun ways that I hope you enjoy seeing :)

Finally 10h mark beaten.

Considering that the 10h was original plan it is quite a surprise how long it took to me. 

Excuses comes here :
-- original design was meant to be effective but large; but you know UPS says nah and I have to use asm3 whenever possible
-- power plant ; yeah it is difficult to have really good powerplant whitch is map friendly too
-- GC outpost - current state use much more energy than necessary; you name it UPS

Anyway I'm quite happy with result, there were some small bugs in BP's but nothing really run wrecking. Surprisingly I had steel issues, but to be honest base was never so much stressed out. Fortunatelly one balancing line saved the day. 

Power was really holding, peak draw at 8.2GW, transition from coal to nuclear was not smoothest, but afterwards I had excess of energy. Lake was fine and I was able to squeeze ~1GW extra from pocket atom blocks.

Finaly base is finally pretty much "bugless" after complete redesign and I'm getting used to it too. Blue sci build is much better in this layout, mall is bit away than, but if you do not forget every single item on a list it is manageable.

Map has good shaped lake and extra space for power blocks late game, on the other hand just a little bit of trees so 60% of run I had to think about it.  Beacon production was half it should be. Science was EXCELENT, all QOL upgrades was made as expected - obtaining modular armor on 3rd blueprint.

Power was really GREAT trough whole run. Lot of space for initial 70-80 MW powerplant with best coal connection ever :D Later power was peaking at 8GW of delivered output and 10GW of "promised" -- but we all know that it is a trap :D

Game finished with 147 - 150k GC/min which looks like my system's manageable maximum (we want more working threads to factorio main loop), Now I have to steepen the hill and make it faster

Interesting facts - during the last few days I encountered that left mouse button operated at "burst" rate for me. This faulty behavior resulted in holes in belt when dragged or belt line side slipping -- all awkward stuff. But real pain was underground pipe placement. In Factorio if you over-paste UP it will switch direction and become useless. This behaviour forced me to change mouse during the run @ 3:46:40 onward.



Afterwards than I have to get to used to play Factorio with my CAD station mouse - it was like pushing the tank trough swamps at first, but in a hour it felt fine. Luckily after run I just swapped battery in my trusty Logitech and it works flawlessly again. Basically "problem" is mouse is pretty worn out and I replaced battery in it just like second time. And to be honest if I had to swap it during time when I had played DooM mostly one cannot observe this burst LMB behavior.

(Note: The final achievement was at 5h10m08s; I was late splitting)

Noteworthy is that i used a save game with the hotbar already setup to start this run. Imo this is no different to creating a new save from the scenario and setting up the hotbar every single time since, as we all know, the game is deterministic. I've talked about it a bit more at the start of the stream, and my conclusion is here: (at 6m 18s) https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1033670223?ab_channel=jansharp&collection=GFo8ZJ6ffBZKDg&t=0h6m18s

If there is a concern that with this approach the scenario script could be modified, well that concern exists regardless. So yea, it doesn't change anything except make restarting less tedious (again, imo).

If there is a problem however, of course feel free to contact me, and as i've said on stream, i have no problem with this run or my future runs getting invalidated.

With that said, i hope you enjoy me speedrunning instead of sleeping ;)

Optimization of my previous 7:42 run.

Changes in routing:
- I mine 2 iron and put it in the 3rd furnace before the 3rd burner drill goes down.
- I mine 8 copper and put it in the 4th furnace (the one that eventually becomes the boiler), which allows me to leave the 3rd furnace on iron longer.
- Trees/wood are all routed to save time, since mining time is now a bottleneck in the early game.
- I make 2 red science before going for stone for the 4th furnace to save on crafting time, which is also a bottleneck before the lab goes down.
- I need to get a 2nd iron axe due to all the mining which costs me 1s in the late game. Maybe could route around this by optimizing wood usage more tightly and/or hand-mining some things without an axe, but seems hard.
- Ending only needs 42 iron due to new fast iron insertion trick where I put 10 iron on the toolbelt and shift-right-click 4 times.
- I played on a lower resolution so that crafting buttons are bigger for better Fitts's Law APM optimization.

Improved my previous PB by 7 min, despite a mediocre early game. I've been having a lot of large (5-8min) Nauvis green splits recently that lose significant time in later planets recently, particularly Fulgora. This run, I made a placement mistake on Nauvis that resulted the planned copper patch for right-side to be under the base and the iron and copper for backside being a lot further than expected, resulting in a huge delay in getting right side up. Despite that placement error, I left Nauvis just under a min green. I had a good Gleba, but had to wait 4 min for the ship to leave Vulcanus to get blue chips that left me 4 seconds green going to Fulgora.  Fulgora went great, so I was 10min green going to Aquilo. I ran out of white science while doing Aquilo research, losing me 3 minutes, so ended up only 7 min green. I credit the faster Fulgora with doubling rocket fuel production on Nauvis, as I discovered last run that my late game rocket launches were fuel-limited.


My current goal is sub-5:44 to move up two on the leaderboard. With a better Nauvis, this is definitely achievable with these prints. Without the copper delay on rightside delayed me leaving Nauvis by minutes and also the 4 min delay leaving Vulcanus. Adding a third space science platform while waiting for module to build on Fulgora should deal with the low space science in the late game.
